title: Torch7 Described at BigLearn, NIPS Workshop
summary: Ronan Collobert's publication record and Idiap's institutional publication record identify the paper 'Torch7: A Matlab-like Environment for Machine Learning' by Ronan Collobert, Koray Kavukcuoglu, and Clément Farabet as a 2011 BigLearn, NIPS Workshop publication describing Torch7 as a Lua-based numeric computing framework and machine-learning library.
significance: A primary/institutional, year-precision documentary milestone for Torch7 that can be recorded without treating 2011 as an exact invention, development-start, or public-release date.

verification.note: The lead author's publication page lists 'Torch7: A Matlab-like Environment for Machine Learning' by R. Collobert, K. Kavukcuoglu, and C. Farabet in BigLearn, NIPS Workshop, 2011, and describes Torch7 as a versatile numeric computing framework and machine-learning library extending Lua. Idiap's institutional publication record independently lists the same title, authors, workshop, and year. This candidate is limited to the documented 2011 paper/workshop milestone and does not infer an exact publication day, invention/system-birth date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or unsupported relationship.
